title: Remove a repeated word
body:
## Summary
Replace 'Read the the guide' with 'Read the guide' in docs/usage.md.

## Testing
Validation plan: render docs/usage.md and check the corrected sentence; no runtime code changes.

## Limitations
Only this sentence is corrected; the rest of the guide has not been audited.

## Breaking changes
None; this is a prose correction.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/usage.md b/docs/usage.md
--- a/docs/usage.md
+++ b/docs/usage.md
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 # Usage
 
-Read the the guide before starting.
+Read the guide before starting.
